sealed_candidate.answer: **No — the packet does not establish service-owner approval for the timed-out release.** Under the delivery policy, production deployment requires approval by the service owner and a recorded rollback plan [delivery-policy]. The packet contains only evidence of a remote completion report following an ambiguous timeout [reliability-context], and the reliability policy explicitly warns that a local checkpoint alone does not prove an external write failed — remote state must be reconciled before retrying [reliability-policy]. Remote completion is evidence of an operation's execution status, not of the required approval or rollback record. No approval record or rollback plan appears anywhere in the supplied sources; the approval determination is therefore unresolved, and no approval should be inferred.
